objective: Frozen ChemBERTa encoder with a newly trained Eye EPA I/II versus III/IV head; no Zein supervision
endpoint: 1=EPA I/II; 0=EPA III/IV. Zero is not absence of all eye irritation.
encoder: Archived mixture-003 checkpoint; DeepChem/ChemBERTa-77M-MLM lineage; no supervised encoder fine-tuning
representation: 384-dimensional nonspecial token mean per original component SMILES, then normalized component-weighted mean. Same disclosed components as Eye LR; no new inferred structures or 11 archived-head covariates.
eligibility: Entire formulation excluded if any component fails tokenizer length/unknown-token check; no truncation or silent ingredient deletion
evaluation: Internal grouped holdout, not independent external validation. Existing 606 evaluation-pool rows partitioned with StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5,shuffle=true,random_state=42), first fold fixed before scoring.
groups: Connected union of existing split_group_id, comp_group_id, structure_group_id, identical wmean vectors; all repeated related formulations kept together. Individual component overlap is allowed and explicitly reported; not a novel-component evaluation.
augmentation: 67 augmentation_train_only rows used for training except any group connected to heldout rows, which is purged
preprocessing: Imputer and StandardScaler fitted on training only
new_head: LogisticRegression C=1.0, max_iter=5000, random_state=42, balanced sample weights computed from training labels, fixed threshold 0.5; no tuning on holdout
LR_comparator: Clone original LR pipeline (C=0.0001), refit on identical training rows with identical balanced sample weights; primary threshold 0.5. Original all-data LR artifact untouched and not scored as an independent holdout baseline.
uncertainty: 2000 paired holdout-group bootstrap resamples, seed=20261109, percentile 95% CI for MCC difference; single-class resamples excluded
limitations: Dataset and prior model choices previously examined; not prospective untouched data
Upstream encoder pretraining overlap unknown; archived MLM was unsupervised
No verified independent EPA external sample set available
STopTox GHS labels not converted to EPA
